bio: Situated in the busy heart of the town, the Zur Post hotel offers its guests a warm, homely welcome, discreet charm and Alpine elegance, while its contemporary-style wine-bar boasts a relaxed and friendly atmosphere. Here, Vincenzo Degasperi, the soul of the restaurant, oversees his guests’ experience with elegant professionalism and genuine hospitality, serving delicious Italian cuisine prepared from the best fresh ingredients. The superb wines are showcased on a skilfully chosen wine list, from which intriguing pairings are also available by the glass....
